Run the unit suite with:

```
make test-fast
```

It skips the Postgres and network integration tests. To run everything, start the database first, then run the full suite:

```
docker compose up db
make test
```

The Makefile has both `test-fast` and `test` targets, which matches what's in the project's stored memory. I didn't run either.
